note: This template shows the structure for dealing cards with decryption proofs

array_mapping.proofs: One proof per card being dealt
array_mapping.init_deltas: Initial deltas for re-encryption (one per card)

instructions.step1: For each card being dealt, generate a decryption proof
instructions.step2: Decrypt each card using your private key
instructions.step4: Fill in all values - arrays must have same length (number of cards being dealt)
instructions.step5: Execute: xiond tx wasm execute $CONTRACT_ADDRESS '<this_json>' --from $ACCOUNT --gas auto -y

example_5_cards.description: If dealing 5 cards, all arrays should have length 5
